chapterBridges.title: Introduction: The Greatest Show On Earth
chapterBridges.nextBridge: If behavior matters more than raw intelligence, the next question is why reasonable people can see money so differently.

chapterBridges.title: No One's Crazy
chapterBridges.nextBridge: Once context explains behavior, the next tension is how much success and failure still depend on luck.
chapterBridges.previousBridge: Introduction: The Greatest Show On Earth

chapterBridges.title: Luck & Risk
chapterBridges.nextBridge: If outcomes can flatter skill, the next chapter asks what happens when success itself stops feeling like enough.

chapterBridges.title: Never Enough
chapterBridges.nextBridge: After warning against endless appetite, the book turns to the strange power of staying in the game for a very long time.

chapterBridges.title: Confounding Compounding
chapterBridges.nextBridge: Compounding needs survival, which leads directly to the difference between becoming wealthy and staying that way.

chapterBridges.title: Getting Wealthy vs. Staying Wealthy
chapterBridges.nextBridge: Once survival is central, the book can explain why a handful of big wins often matter more than steady averages.

chapterBridges.title: Tails, You Win
chapterBridges.nextBridge: From market payoffs, the book shifts to a more human dividend of money: the freedom to control your own time.

chapterBridges.title: Freedom
chapterBridges.nextBridge: After defining money's best use, the book shows why status spending often fails to deliver the admiration it promises.

chapterBridges.title: Man in the Car Paradox
chapterBridges.nextBridge: From visible symbols, Housel moves to the hidden nature of real wealth itself.

chapterBridges.title: Wealth Is What You Don't See
chapterBridges.nextBridge: Once wealth is understood as unspent capacity, the next chapter asks why saving matters even before you know exactly what it is for.

chapterBridges.title: Save Money
chapterBridges.nextBridge: That flexibility matters because perfect textbook logic is less useful than behavior you can actually sustain.
chapterBridges.previousBridge: Wealth Is What You Don't See

chapterBridges.title: Reasonable > Rational
chapterBridges.nextBridge: Even durable plans must face the fact that history is repeatedly shaped by surprises that no forecast sees clearly in advance.

chapterBridges.title: Surprise!
chapterBridges.nextBridge: That humility about surprise becomes a concrete design rule in the next chapter: build room for error.

chapterBridges.title: Room for Error
chapterBridges.nextBridge: Even robust plans meet another problem: the person making them will not stay exactly the same over time.

chapterBridges.title: You'll Change
chapterBridges.nextBridge: That flexibility matters because every attractive return also comes with an emotional price that must be paid.

chapterBridges.title: Nothing's Free
chapterBridges.nextBridge: That emotional price looks very different depending on what game a person is actually playing.

chapterBridges.title: You & Me
chapterBridges.nextBridge: Once different players are visible, the book can explain why pessimistic stories often dominate shared attention.

chapterBridges.title: The Seduction of Pessimism
chapterBridges.nextBridge: That appetite for neat dramatic stories helps explain why people will often believe almost anything after the fact.

chapterBridges.title: When You'll Believe Anything
chapterBridges.nextBridge: With the book's distortions now visible, Housel closes by gathering the durable rules that survive all of them.

chapterBridges.title: All Together Now
chapterBridges.nextBridge: The book then turns personal and historical: first the author's own confessions, then the American consumer story behind many modern defaults.

chapterBridges.title: Confessions
chapterBridges.nextBridge: The postscript then widens the frame from personal preference to the historical forces that shaped modern American consumption.

chapterBridges.title: Postscript: A Brief History of Why the U.S. Consumer Thinks the Way They Do
chapterBridges.nextBridge: No next chapter. The postscript widens the reader's lens so the entire book sits inside history rather than floating above it.
